articles.title: King leads solemn Remembrance service at Cenotaph
articles.description: Wreaths are laid as 10,000 armed forces veterans, including 12 from World War Two, pay tribute in central London.

articles.title: Watch: Royals and veterans reflect at Remembrance ceremony
articles.description: King Charles has led the annual Remembrance Sunday commemorations, laying a wreath at the solemn ceremony held at the Cenotaph.

articles.title: 'Time is up': Minister warns media industry to take abuse seriously in wake of Brand case
articles.description: Lisa Nandy tells the BBC "many people" in the media industry have come forward to her.

articles.title: Government 'looking seriously' at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
articles.description: The culture secretary confirms reports they could be in the list of platforms set to be banned next March.
